top_signals.title: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget
top_signals.summary: The 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, and will include a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.

top_signals.title: Primavera's Hu Discusses China Markets, AI Bubble
top_signals.summary: Fred Hu, Founder, Chairman and CEO at Primavera Capital, says Chinese policymakers should focus on strengthening the economy’s fundamentals to give investors the confidence to deploy long-term capital. He speaks exclusively on the sidelines of Hong Kong FinTech Week. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Binance net outflows surge to $5.8B as withdrawals resume after record hack

top_signals.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows as withdrawals resume after massive hack
top_signals.summary: Binance recorded $3.64 billion in net outflows after resuming withdrawals following a $6.3 billion hack, representing 2.1% of its total assets.

top_signals.title: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy has stroke and is in the hospital, office says
top_signals.summary: Sen. Chris Murphy's office announced Sunday that he suffered a stroke and was hospitalized the day prior, though they say he is 'awake and alert.'
